house.description: Duluth Air National Guard Base new aircraft shelters funding provided, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for new aircraft shelters at the Duluth Air National Guard Base.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+148TH FIGHTER WING AIRCRAFT SHELTERS; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$25,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the adjutant general for removal of old single-bay shelters and construction of new universal aircraft parking shelters for the 148th Fighter Wing, Minnesota Air National Guard at the Duluth Air National Guard Base. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until spent, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for new aircraft shelters at the Duluth Air National Guard Base.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. 148TH FIGHTER WING AIRCRAFT SHELTERS; APPROPRIATION.

$25,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the adjutant general for removal of old single-bay shelters and construction of new universal aircraft parking shelters for the 148th Fighter Wing, Minnesota Air National Guard at the Duluth Air National Guard Base. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until spent, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $25,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the adjutant general for removal of old single-bay shelters and construction of new universal aircraft parking shelters for the 148th Fighter Wing, Minnesota Air National Guard at the Duluth Air National Guard Base. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until spent, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
